entries.039d6b8b9fc2153b: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, gross profit, calculated by deducting cost of sales of ¥458,857 million from revenue, was ¥83,028 million (up 7.9% year on year), and selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥70,986 million (up 5.3% year on year).
entries.066df5021906b01f: This business division sells cutting tools, tooling, auxiliary tools, measuring and metrology instruments, grinding, whetstone and diamond tools, work, piping and power tools, hydraulic and pneumatic tools, welding machines, cutting machines, sheet-metal working machinery, small machine tools, construction and material-handling equipment, chemical products, ＯＡ and office equipment, home appliances, and other products. The MD&A states that although sales of consumables such as cutting tools were affected by capital investment trends among small and medium-sized manufacturers, sales of various work supplies and small equipment used at production sites were solid. It also states that in sales of cutting and auxiliary tools and other products, the company expanded electronic transactions and held large-scale exhibition-style business meetings planned by the company in various regions as a “real platform for revitalizing regional economies.” Sales for this business division alone are not printed in the annual securities report.
entries.1ae6bf4fb1fa683f: Headquartered in Nishi-ku, Osaka City, the company handles production goods (machine tools and machinery tools, etc.) and consumer goods (housing equipment and home-life products, etc.). The securities report divides its business into three reportable [[term:segment|segments]]: Production Goods-Related Business, Housing Business and Household Equipment Business. As of March 31, 2026, consolidated headcount was 3,309, and there are 21 [[term:consolidated-subsidiary|consolidated subsidiaries]]. Overseas, it has local subsidiaries in the United States, Mexico, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, China, Germany and South Korea.

entries.40237ebe359e444a: This business delivers machine tools, cutting tools and other products to manufacturing sites. The securities report describes this business as a business field that supports “Monozukuri” (manufacturing) through the supply of machine tools and machinery tools, etc. It is the largest of the Group's three reportable segments; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥349,218 million (up 4.8% year on year), and segment profit was ¥10,423 million (¥8,291 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025). The securities report describes this business by dividing it into the Domestic Production Goods Business and the Overseas Production Goods Business. Domestically there are three divisions: the Machinery Division, Industrial Solutions Division and Tools & Engineering Division; overseas there is the Overseas Division. Revenue by domestic and overseas business and by division is not printed in the securities report; readers can check on the page only the amounts for the reportable segments.
entries.496bf024a3141908: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥541,885 million (up 5.0% year on year). The Production Goods Business recorded ¥349,218 million (up 4.8%), the Home Appliance Business ¥101,560 million (up 0.7%) and the Housing and Construction Business ¥87,403 million (up 11.2%), and the Service Business, which is not identified as a business segment, recorded ¥3,702 million. Revenue from merchandise is recorded at the time of delivery or customer acceptance, and revenue from contract construction work is recorded at the time of customer acceptance. However, if the period from shipment to delivery or acceptance is a normal period in Japan, revenue is recorded at the time of shipment. Consideration for transactions is mainly received within 5 months after the performance obligation is fulfilled.
entries.4acb36af065de352: This category is not included in reportable segments. The annual securities report’s Business Overview states that the business carries out event planning, travel arrangement, and warehousing and storage, among other activities, and it lists Yamazen Kurieito Co., Ltd., Rojiraizu Co., Ltd. and Toraberu Topia Co., Ltd. as principal affiliates. The segment information includes service businesses such as event planning that are not identified as operating segments, together with head office functions, in the “Other” category under “Adjustments”; the MD&A’s sales results state that sales of service businesses not identified as operating segments were ¥3,702 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.5ff9400ed9e250c1: This business division sells machine tools (machining centers, CNC lathes, CNC grinders, CNC milling machines, electrical discharge machines, general-purpose machine tools, 3D printers, etc.), forging and sheet-metal machinery (presses, shearing machines, bending machines, laser cutting machines), injection molding machines, die-casting machines, CAD/CAM, and machine tool peripherals (industrial robots, measuring instruments, automation peripherals, etc.), among other products. The MD&A states that, for machine tools, sales to automotive parts processing manufacturers were slightly below the previous year. On the other hand, it worked on approaches to industries such as shipbuilding, aviation and defense, and on proposal-based sales aimed at mid-sized and small and medium-sized enterprises using large-scale growth investment subsidies and other programs, and it states that in the fourth quarter it captured demand from parts manufacturers of semiconductor equipment, where recovery was clear, and that orders were strong. Sales for this business division alone are not printed in the annual securities report.
entries.61d66aeaf02c01f0: Related contracted construction and services, event planning, travel arrangement, and warehousing and storage
entries.6237a5d17458e633: This division sells material handling equipment, packing and packaging systems, picking and sorter systems, automated warehouses, labor-saving and automation systems, conveying equipment, AGV and AMR, robot systems, hydraulic and pneumatic equipment, environmental improvement equipment, dust collectors, wastewater treatment facilities, pumps, blowers, air conditioning systems, compressors, welding equipment and more. The company history states that in April 2023 the Machinery Division was split into the Industrial Solutions Division and the Tool & Engineering Division. The MD&A states that, in response to needs for automation and labor saving, sales of equipment that reduces work load and of environmental improvement equipment aimed at improving the working environment were favorable, and that proposals for automation solutions at manufacturing and logistics sites were strengthened. Net sales of this division alone are not printed in the securities report.
entries.6248e4aa29d28cd0: This business plans, develops and sells home appliances, interior furniture, outdoor and leisure goods, and kitchen and daily necessities, and is handled by the Household Appliances Division. The annual securities report positions it, together with the Housing and Construction Business, as a consumer goods-related business (a business field that proposes “creating comfortable living spaces” through the supply of housing equipment, home-life products and other items). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer sales were ¥101,560 million (up 0.7% year on year), and segment profit was ¥4,810 million (¥4,449 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025). The MD&A states that it expanded private brand products through quick planning and development based on marketing activities that analyzed customer feedback, and that it aims to spread the YAMAZEN brand through information dissemination using SNS and other channels. Revenue increased, reflecting strong sales of fan-equipped wear and portable air conditioners during the intense heat of last summer, along with growth in EC. Sales and membership numbers also grew at the company’s own EC site for corporations and sole proprietors, “Yamazen Bizukomu.” The capital expenditure overview states that the company newly established “Rojisu EC Kantō,” an EC-dedicated base for the Household Appliances Business, which began operating in April 2026.

entries.6e94e6835c175fcf: This category is listed as the 2nd of the production goods-related businesses in the "Description of Business" of the securities report, and is handled by the Overseas Division. It is stated to carry out the import and export of machine tools, injection molding machines, electronics and semiconductor equipment, machine tool peripherals, cutting tools, measuring instruments, component parts, robots and automation equipment, environmental equipment and more, support for the overseas relocation of overseas procurement and production plants, trilateral trade, total planning of factory production equipment and systems, and the procurement and sale of product materials. There are 15 main affiliated companies, located in the United States (2 companies), Mexico, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Taiwan, China (3 companies), Germany and South Korea. The company history states that this Overseas Division was established in April 2025 by reclassifying the domestic and overseas categories. The MD&A states that in the fiscal year ended March 2026, although performance fluctuated by branch up to the 3rd quarter, all branches exceeded the previous year's results for the full year. It states that the North America branch captured demand related to the aerospace industry, power generation and data centers, the Taiwan branch captured demand related to AI and semiconductors, and the ASEAN branch captured demand for production transfers from other countries in addition to domestic demand. It also states that, toward "accelerating global expansion," it acquired all shares of AtoG1 Co., Ltd., the parent company of a machine tool trading company in Malaysia, in February 2026, and all shares of PT. Somagede Indonesia, a machinery and tool trading company in Indonesia, in March, making both companies subsidiaries. Net sales of this category alone are not printed in the securities report.

entries.83c0eab835c1c0e7: For production goods, it handles machine tools, forging and sheet-metal machinery, injection molding machines, cutting tools, measuring instruments and material handling equipment, among others; for consumer goods, it handles housing equipment such as kitchen, bathroom, water heating, and air conditioning and ventilation-related equipment, and home-life products such as home appliances, interior furniture, and outdoor and leisure goods. The Production Goods-Related Business and the Housing Business also perform contracted construction and related work in addition to sales. The Household Equipment Business plans and develops private-brand products based on marketing activities drawing on analysis of customer voices, and the securities report states that the share of many of the group's private-brand products in total handling volume has been rising year by year. For storage and shipment of products, it uses warehouse facilities including Logis Kanto, Logis Tokyo and Logis Osaka, and from April 2026 the EC-dedicated base “Logis EC Kanto” of the Household Equipment Business has also started operating.

entries.8dd0fdc8cfd2dcd1: It is a company that purchases products from suppliers such as manufacturers and sells them to customers. The independent auditor's report in the securities report states that there are inventory transactions shipped from company-managed warehouses, and direct shipment transactions in which products are delivered from suppliers directly to customers without passing through company-managed warehouses. Sales are generated from the sale of machine tools and other machinery products and contracted construction (Production Goods-Related Business), the sale of housing equipment and contracted construction (Housing Business), and the sale of home-life products (Household Equipment Business). entries.bf5c1512e236134f: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, gross profit, calculated by deducting cost of sales of ¥458,857 million from revenue, was ¥83,028 million (up 7.9% year on year), and selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥70,986 million (up 5.3% year on year). The MD&A states that the increase in selling, general and administrative expenses was due to higher personnel costs and commission payments. Operating profit was ¥12,041 million (up 26.3% year on year), and the operating profit margin on revenue was 2.2%. Segment profit was ¥10,423 million for the Production Goods Business, ¥4,810 million for the Home Appliance Business and ¥3,662 million for the Housing and Construction Business, and the annual securities report states that segment profit is reconciled to operating profit in the consolidated statement of income. Corporate expenses not attributable to reportable segments were ¥6,911 million. Ordinary profit was ¥13,010 million (up 29.9% year on year), and profit attributable to owners of parent was ¥9,330 million (up 18.9% year on year).
entries.c034be45cbb2f2af: This is the category listed first under Production Goods-Related Business in the securities report's “Business Description” section, and it is handled by three divisions: the Machinery Division, Industrial Solutions Division and Tools & Engineering Division. Its main affiliated companies are Ogaki Kiko Co., Ltd., Toho Kogyo Co., Ltd. and Ishihara Giken Co., Ltd. For Japan in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the MD&A states that new capital investment by small and medium-sized manufacturers, the end users, was generally sluggish, while demand for automation and labor-saving measures to address labor shortages was high, and energy-saving-related capital investment, driven by persistently high energy prices, was also firm. Revenue for this category alone is not printed in the securities report.

entries.e9acb46d245482bb: This business sells housing equipment such as kitchen equipment, bathroom equipment, washstand equipment, water heaters, sanitary equipment, and air-conditioning and ventilation-related equipment, as well as building materials such as interior and exterior building materials and sashes, and also carries out related construction work and services; it is handled by the Housing and Construction Division. The annual securities report positions it, together with the Household Appliances Business, as a consumer goods-related business. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer sales were ¥87,403 million (up 11.2% year on year), and segment profit was ¥3,662 million (¥3,192 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025). The MD&A states that, in addition to strong sales of air-conditioning equipment driven by demand from extreme heat and energy-saving renovations, sales of water heaters and other equipment also grew, as the company focused on proposing high value-added products that match consumers’ thrift-minded preferences amid persistently high utility costs. It also states that the company worked to develop non-residential markets and strengthened renovation proposals that bundle environmentally friendly products with installation work, to meet small and medium-sized enterprises’ needs for carbon neutrality and lower utility costs.
